/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { chromium } from '/home/vercel-sandbox/.npm/_npx/420ff84f11983ee5/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage()
  const errors = []
  page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
  await page.evaluate(() => { window.__migrationNavigationMarker = 'preserved' })
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'View All Posts' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All Blog Posts' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.post-card').count(), 100)
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Read More', exact: true }).nth(10).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog/11')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Comments (5)' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.comment').count(), 5)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '← Back' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog')
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.__migrationNavigationMarker), 'preserved')
  assert.equal(await page.title(), 'Blog - My Blog')
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/not-a-real-page')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: '404 - Page Not Found' }).waitFor()
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Go Back Home' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('http://localhost:3000/')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
  assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
  console.log('PASS: browser hydration, client navigation, post comments, back button, titles, and 404 recovery')

  const errorPage = await browser.newPage()
  await errorPage.goto('http://localhost:3001/')
  await errorPage.getByText('Sorry, something went wrong.').waitFor()
  await errorPage.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try Again' }).click()
  await errorPage.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
  console.log('PASS: production error boundary retries a failed server fetch and recovers')
} finally {
  await browser.close()
}
NODE"
